compiled:
📰 General

Altria Considers Major Bid for Imperial Brands, Signaling Industry Shift •

Altria, the US-based Marlboro maker, is reportedly exploring a substantial cash offer for Imperial Brands, a leading UK tobacco company. This potential deal would unite three major tobacco firms, collectively holding a considerable portion of the worldwide cigarette market. Analysts suggest this move could represent one of the largest transactions in the industry’s history. The discussions are currently underway, with details of a possible carve-up of assets also being examined.

🌍 World

Huntingdon Train Attack: Knifeman Found Guilty of Attempted Murder of 14 •

Anthony Williams, 33, was found guilty following a trial at the Old Bailey of attempting to murder fourteen individuals, including ten passengers on a train travelling from Doncaster to King’s Cross. The attack occurred in May 2023 when Williams boarded the train and attacked passengers with a knife. Passengers successfully subdued Williams, preventing further injuries. The court heard that Williams had a history of mental health issues and had previously been cautioned for assault.

🦅 US

Spanish Economist Selected as New Head of the European Central Bank •

The European Council has reached an agreement to recommend Pablo Hernandez de Cos, a Spanish economist, as the next president of the European Central Bank (ECB). This selection follows a lengthy process involving nominations from member states. Hernandez de Cos’s appointment marks a significant shift in leadership for the ECB, which manages monetary policy for the 19-nation Eurozone. The decision was announced by European Council President Antonio Costa, signifying a formal endorsement of the candidate.

💰 Business

Amazon and Walmart Engage in Fierce Competition for Holiday Shopping Revenue •

Amazon and Walmart are actively competing for market share during the upcoming holiday shopping season, anticipating increased consumer spending. The International Council of Shopping Centers projects a significant rise in retail sales, fueling the rivalry between the two giants. Both companies are initiating Black Friday sales promotions in preparation for heightened demand. Analysts predict a substantial portion of the $124 billion projected holiday retail market will be contested between these major players.

💻 Technology

Ford’s GT41 Race Car Returns to Le Mans, Aiming for Historic Victory •

Ford has revealed the GT41, a new hypercar designed to challenge for the 24 Hours of Le Mans title. The vehicle’s development follows six decades since Ford’s last victory with the GT40 in 1966. The GT41 incorporates a hybrid powertrain and advanced aerodynamics, aiming to improve performance significantly. Ford’s return to the race represents a renewed commitment to endurance racing and a strategic attempt to recapture past success.

🎭 Entertainment

Brad Pitt’s Latest Netflix Thriller Faces a Disappointing Audience Score •

Brad Pitt’s new 140-minute R-rated thriller, The Further Misadventures of Cliff Booth, has received a notably low audience score on Netflix. Initial data indicates a significant portion of viewers did not enjoy the film, signaling a divergence from Pitt’s typically successful filmography. The lengthy runtime of 140 minutes contributed to the negative reception, with many finding it excessive. Despite Pitt’s established star power and previous critical and commercial successes, this film’s performance suggests a less favorable reception among viewers.

🏅 Sports

Christian Watson Enters Concussion Protocol Following Rams Game Hit •

Green Bay Packers wide receiver Christian Watson has been placed in the NFL’s concussion protocol following a significant hit during Wednesday’s game against the Los Angeles Rams. The injury occurred in the second quarter when Watson collided with Rams safety Michael Rappoaport. Medical staff evaluated Watson immediately after the play, and he was subsequently removed from the game. The extent of the injury and Watson’s recovery timeline remain uncertain at this time.

🔬 Science

ESA’s Hera Mission Captures Stunning Images of Dart’s Impact Crater •

The European Space Agency’s Hera mission has successfully imaged the substantial crater created by NASA’s DART mission on the asteroid Dimorphos. Launched in 2022, the DART mission intentionally impacted the asteroid at approximately 15,000 miles per hour to test a planetary defense system. The resulting crater is roughly stadium-sized, demonstrating the force of the collision. Scientists are analyzing the data to understand the composition of Dimorphos and the effectiveness of the deflection technique.

🩺 Health

Turkey Triggers Alarm: One Food Causes Majority of Holiday Choking Deaths •

According to a recent study, whole turkey is the leading cause of choking incidents during the Thanksgiving holiday. Approximately 50% of all holiday-related choking cases involve the consumption of the poultry. Researchers attribute this high rate to the size and texture of the turkey, particularly the bones and skin. The study recommends taking precautions such as cutting turkey into smaller pieces and supervising children while eating.
